**Finding: deviation (fallback target) — LICENSE, Section 2 grants**

- **Compliant aspects:** §2.1 hosting licence is "perpetual and irrevocable"; §2.2/§2.3 are "fully paid up, perpetual"; all grants are "nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1)", and §14.1 permits assignment without consent on a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets — so the fallback successor-transfer element is already met (direct-competitor consent carve-out noted only as a minor point).
- **Failure:** no grant, and no definition anywhere in the Agreement, extends the licences to Corio's affiliates; "Customer(s)" means Corio's sublicensed hosting customers, not affiliates, so there is no existing path to affiliate coverage.
- **Cure:** one inserted subsection 2.11 extending the Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates on written notice, with a short control-based descriptor to avoid an undefined term. All other grant language left verbatim; no contractor/perpetuity upgrades added beyond the fallback checklist.
